name: Grilled Steak with Mango Salsa & Spinach-Tomato Salad

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together olive oil, lime juice, honey, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
juice of 1 ½ limes
1 ½ tsp honey
3 pinches salt
3 pinches black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Season steak with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg ribeye steak
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.

Wash mangoes and jalapeños. Peel the mangoes, slice flesh away from the pit, small dice, and transfer to a medium bowl. Seed, mince, and add jalapeños to bowl. Peel, small dice, and add onion to bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 mangoes
3 jalapeño peppers
1 ½ medium red onion

instructions.primary_message: Add lime juice, honey, and salt to salsa; mix to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
juice of 1 ½ limes
¾ tsp honey
⅜ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry spinach. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Wash and halve tomatoes. Add to bowl with spinach.
Place steak on a plate and top with mango salsa. Add salad on the side and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!
